# Digital Growth Lab™

We engineer predictable organic rankings, high-converting web applications, and data-driven advertising campaigns for ambitious brands and digital-first enterprises worldwide.

## Core Services & Capabilities
- [Guaranteed Google Page #1 SEO](https://digitallabgrowth.com/services.html): Algorithmic technical SEO, search engine penalty mitigation, schema structured data, GEO/AEO optimization, and high-authority link acquisition.
- [High-ROAS Google & Meta Ads Management](https://digitallabgrowth.com/services.html): Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Instagram and Facebook full-funnel ad management with real-time conversion tracking and zero ad-spend waste.
- [Conversion Web Design & Full-Stack Development](https://digitallabgrowth.com/services.html): High-speed, mobile-responsive corporate sites, SaaS applications, custom e-commerce platforms, and interactive client portals. Starting price for a simple website is ₹15,000 (prices depend on custom features and scope of work requested).
- [Google Business Profile (GMB) & Local SEO Dominance](https://digitallabgrowth.com/services.html): Map pack 3-pack rankings, review generation, local entity signaling, and online reputation management (ORM).
- [Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)](https://digitallabgrowth.com/services.html): Scientific UX heatmapping, A/B landing page testing, and sales funnel velocity acceleration.
- [Social Media Management & Commercial Video Production](https://digitallabgrowth.com/services.html): Engaging short-form Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, brand narrative storytelling, and viral asset creation.
